subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock-mantle): dedupe the IAM token-failure diagnostic per region (#67288)

question: Should a continuously failing Bedrock Mantle region emit only its first IAM-token failure until success or restart, or should failures be rate-limited periodically so changed causes remain visible?
rationale: Both policies are technically viable, but balancing log-spam prevention against evolving operator diagnostics requires product and operations intent that source correctness and CI cannot settle.

options.title: Accept first-failure visibility
options.body: Keep the process-lifetime per-region guard, preserving every IAM retry while emitting again only after success or restart.

options.title: Use periodic reminder logging
options.body: Replace the lifetime guard with a time-bounded limiter so persistent or changed failures become visible again without returning to per-request spam.

recommendation.title: Accept first-failure visibility
recommendation.body: Keep the process-lifetime per-region guard, preserving every IAM retry while emitting again only after success or restart.

likelyOwner.reason: The IAM authentication and token-refresh behavior originated in their merged work, so they are best positioned to choose its operational diagnostic cadence.
